 Current Form Lumbini Lions: 
 Lumbini Lions finished at the 1st position on points table after league stages and they will now face Sudurpaschim Royals in the Qualifier 1 Match.
 The top run scorer for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is D'Arcy Short with 148 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Sher Malla with 9 scalps under his belt .
 Lumbini Lions have won their previous match against Biratnagar Kings by 4 wickets.
 Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a total of 166 for 4 in 20 overs. Imran Sheikh and Lokesh Bam collected 33 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Sheikh made 24 runs while Bam scored 15. Charith Asalanka and Shubham Ranjane played to their potential in the middle order. Asalanka scored 64 off 43 balls while Ranjane made 31 runs in 24 deliveries. On the back of their brilliance with the bat, Biratnagar Kings managed to reach a competitive total of 166 on a tough surface to bat on.
 During the chase, D'Arcy Short and Aasif Sheikh started off very well for Lumbini Lions. They added 86 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Short and Sheikh both made 45 each to seal the deal in favor of Lumbini Lions. A couple of wickets fell in quick succession in the middle overs but Ali Sheikh and Sundeep Jora had their back. They smashed 27 and 25 runs respectively and helped Lions get over the line on the second last ball of the match with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Sudurpaschim Royals: 
 Sudurpaschim Royals finished at the 1st position on points table after league stages and they will now face Lumbini Lions in the Qualifier 1 Match
 The top run scorer for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dipendra Singh Airee with 150 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Anil Kharel with 10 scalps under his belt .
 Sudurpaschim Royals have won their previous match against Kathmandu Gorkhas by 7 runs.
 Sudurpaschim Royals batted first and they were restricted to an under par total of 125 for 6 in 20 overs. Scott Kuggeleijn, Binod Bhandari, Brandon McMullen and Ishan Pandey all got out without troubling the scorers much. After that phase, Dipendra Singh Airee played a captain's knock of 60 runs in 55 balls.  He was well supported by Tharindu Ratnayake, who scored 26 runs. On the back of these two knocks, Sudurpaschim Royals managed to reach 125 in their innings.
 During the chase, Kathmandu Gorkhas lost their way right from the word go. They were reduced to 48 for 5 in the 10th over. Rashid Khan fought hard and scored 35 runs he barely got any support from the other batters. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Sudurpaschim Royals kept it really tight in the death overs. Kathmandu Gorkhas couldn't make the final push and they were eventually restricted to 118 for 7 in 20 overs, falling short of the target by 7 runs.
